scope: Phase 4 source discovery, local build, installation, compatibility, and recovery

scenarios.observation: A clean exact checkout exposed the additive source catalog without altering schema-one market.toml.
Refresh cached metadata without starting Cargo, installing a package, or executing module code.
The CLI built the pinned source with locked preparation and offline bounded compilation.
Atomic publication installed the validated package outside Git and disabled.
The TUI Build and install action observed completion for the exact final catalog identity.
The TUI required explicit enablement and then prepared the selected module command.
The TUI launched the built executable through the native module host and observed its status.
Real Chromium observed source, preparation, compilation, packaging, and installed phases.
The WebUI observed disabled installation, explicit enablement, and the module draft.
A second process recognized the exact live PID and birth-token owner without false interruption.
Cross-process cancellation stopped the exact compile scope and retained no install identity.
Abrupt owner loss during dependency preparation reconciled to interrupted and stopped the orphan scope.
A fresh explicit retry installed successfully after cancellation and owner loss.
An unapproved lockfile dependency source failed before compilation while the prior package remained selected.
A deliberate Rust compile error failed inside the offline scope while the prior package remained selected.
The existing schema-one Deep Research package remained loadable at its original digest.
The released old client read catalog.json and installed identities while ignoring source-only data.
The clean market checkout retained no Red Team binary, package, cache, build, or campaign output.
All named build scopes were absent after terminal and recovered attempts.
